test_quat_rotate: test quat_rotate to rotate a 3D vector by a quaternion using JAX transformations
test_pos_quat_mul: test pos_quat_mul to compose two position-quaternion poses using JAX transformations
test_quat_to_mat: test quat_to_mat to convert a quaternion to a 3x3 rotation matrix using JAX
test_pos_quat_to_hmat: test pos_quat_to_hmat to build a 4x4 homogeneous transformation matrix from position and quaternion
test_velocity_transform: test velocity_transform to transform a 6D twist vector by a homogeneous transformation matrix
